Double `foo` expected `save('{
    "id": 1,
    "name": "baz",
    "active": true
}')` to be called exactly 1 time, but it was never called.

The following similar call was made to `save`:
  body:
      ...
          "id": 1,
    -     "name": "baz",
    +     "name": "Baz",
          "active": true
      ...
